about.heroDesc: At Sect, we believe that every handmade piece carries a story — a story of talent, culture, and love. We bring together skilled artisans from around the world to share their unique creations with you.
about.dreamTitle:
A Dream that
Started with Handmade
about.dreamDesc1: Sect was born from a simple belief: handmade crafts have the power to connect people - across cultures, across borders, and across hearts.
about.dreamDesc2: What started as a small passion project quickly grew into a global platform, supporting artisans and bringing their timeless creations to you.
about.valuesDesc: We're more than a store. We're a community that values people, culture and craftsmanship. These are the principles that guide us every day.
about.val1Desc: Every piece is handmade, original and full of character.
about.val2Desc: We support artisans and help them grow their livelihoods.
about.val3Desc: We celebrate traditions and keep timeless skills alive.
about.val4Desc: We choose eco-friendly materials and ethical practices.
about.val5Desc: We build a global community of creators, collectors and dreamers.
about.makersDesc: From cozy villages to buzzing cities, our artisans pour their hearts into every piece. We work directly with them, ensuring fair wages, safe working conditions, and a platform to showcase their talent to the world.
